test_title: PYST 42: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some tabs are medicines.

Some tabs are ointments.

Some medicines are branches.

Conclusions:

(I): Some tabs are branches.

(II): Some medicines are ointments.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7064c85c3b538be2d9aeb5ad45c0f8605bc717909df736254102a4cb9bfa2af.png] 

Conclusions:**
(I): Some tabs are branches. - False(As their is no relation between tabs and branches may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II): Some medicines are ointments.- False (As their is no relation between medicines and ointments may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"**
